name: sched_getaffinity
synopsis: int sched_getaffinity(pid_t pid, size_t cpusetsize, cpu_set_t *mask);
description: sched_getaffinity retrieves the CPU affinity mask for a specified thread and stores it in a cpu_set_t structure. It allows querying which CPUs a thread is eligible to run on, with the mask specifying the set of CPUs. If the pid is zero, it returns the mask for the calling thread.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The ID of the thread to query; if 0, uses the calling thread

parameters.name: cpusetsize
parameters.description: The size in bytes of the mask buffer

parameters.name: mask
parameters.description: Pointer to the cpu_set_t structure where the affinity mask is stored

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: A supplied memory address was invalid
cpusetsize is smaller than the size of the affinity mask used by the kernel
The thread whose ID is pid could not be found
